title: Bug 646576: Preserve manually changed component Flushing Method on subcontracting transfers
summary: Production order components in subcontracting transfers no longer lose their manually set Flushing Method when moved to or from the subcontractor location. A new helper function preserves the Flushing Method during automatic location changes while maintaining all validation side effects.
key_points: New helper function ValidateProdOrderCompLocationPreservingFlushingMethod preserves the Flushing Method during automatic subcontracting location moves
Flushing Method is captured before location validation and restored via plain assignment afterward to avoid triggering OnValidate errors
All subcontracting location shuttles updated: forward/return transfer reports, direct-transfer posts, and component restore operations
Plain assignment ensures Bin Code remains unchanged and avoids validation errors on Backward flushing method with consumption entries
Comprehensive test coverage added with forward transfer and full lifecycle tests demonstrating the fix works with partial consumption
